mapper.sql: select id, name, type_id, platform_id, kind_id, icon, maintain, recommend, large_icon, effect, create_time, sort from game_info
mapper.select: select p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, a.* from (select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, i.kind_id, i.platform_id, i.sort from game_info i where i.type_id = #{typeId}) a left join game_platform p on p.id = a.platform_id order by a.sort asc

select p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, a.* from (select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, i.kind_id, i.platform_id, i.sort from game_info i where i.effect = 1 and i.type_id = #{typeId}) a left join game_platform p on p.id = a.platform_id where p.effect = 1 order by a.sort asc

select p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, a.* from (select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, i.kind_id, i.platform_id, i.sort from game_info i where i.effect = 1 and i.type_id = #{typeId} and i.platform_id = #{platformId}) a left join game_platform p on p.id = a.platform_id where p.effect = 1 order by a.sort asc
